summary: Learn PPP performance monitoring, payment checks, change control, and reporting. Review the five-day course and practical syllabus.
lede: PPP contract management covers how public authorities and contract managers oversee obligations, service performance and payments after financial close. Participants practise maintaining KPI evidence, checking payment adjustments, recording contract changes and mapping dispute escalation, then prepare an oversight report. Digital reporting and AI-assisted exception screening are introduced at a conceptual, appropriately scoped level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals accountable for public oversight of PPP agreements, service obligations, payments, and contract records after financial close.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of public contracting, PPP agreements, or infrastructure contract administration is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet-based monitoring exercises; no specialist software installation is required.
